title: AI Adoption in Recruitment: Insights from the Latest Enterprise Hiring Trends Report
description: A recent report reveals that 81% of enterprise hiring teams have adopted AI, yet only 6.6% have fully integrated it into their processes. The study highlights the rapid scaling of AI in larger organizations and its significant impact on job description creation and resume screening. While challenges remain, particularly in onboarding and interview scheduling, the focus is shifting towards effective deployment. Discover how AI is reshaping recruitment strategies across various industries and what this means for the future of hiring.
